note: Fixed before any model run (decision-criteria.md). #1867: the generation part of the evaluation plan (../EVAL_PLAN.md). ASC installed the way it reaches a user (project-assets --register-claude-skill --apply in a dedicated worktree, the read trigger claude-md adopted), in the isolated write-tools environment of #1840 (tools level W, no Bash, no network, no browser). B = the release v0.5.131 (the current main 221283eb, 17 Skills); S = B plus the candidate Skill design-creation (packed from a commit that adds it and is reverted in the next commit, as #1815). The four design cases of the plan: the #1804 briefs and fixture files unchanged (sha256 pinned below) and the new lp-new. The harness records only what a machine can count (whether the design-creation body and references were read, whether the deliverables were written); what the design record says (the user picture with evidence and hypotheses, the decisions tied to users) is counted afterwards by a fresh context, blind to the condition (decision-criteria.md; layers/gate-count.json).
fixedExtraNote: #1867 (review H2): the settings of the gate count, layer 1, layer 2 and layer 3, run outside the shared harness, are fixed with the plan (fixation.mjs hashes them as config/layers/...). The harness scripts of ../harness/ and the #1835 tools are not hashed here; they are named by the fixation commit.
modelNote: Same alias as #1804, #1815 and #1840-#1846. The resolved model id (init event) is recorded per trial.
runsNote: The plan: 3 runs per condition and case (24 trials). Only reps 1..runs are scored; a later rep counts only as the one mandatory replacement of a failed trial.
ascSkillsNote: The 17 Skills of the release v0.5.131 (B).
ascSkillsByConditionNote: S distributes the 17 Skills and design-creation (shared harness #1867: score.mjs ascSkillsOf, probe-check.mjs ascEntriesOf, dry-run.mjs). B keeps ascSkills.
maxTurnsNote: Every fixture is a design folder generated to the end (the deliverables need the final state): no --max-turns, unlike the three-message design trials of #1820 stage 2; the per-trial budget bounds the cost. The cases have kind page (not design), so they are scored as full trials (score.mjs isDesign).
probeFixtureNote: One isolation probe per condition on fixture LP. The design folders have no user Skill, so every .claude/skills entry is an ASC entry of the condition (17 in B, 18 in S). The isolation steps do not depend on the fixture.

budget.note: The owner cap of 20 USD is for the generation and layer 2 (P) of #1867 together (owner 2026-11-28, Issue #1867 comment). The generation is allocated 12 USD (ownerCapUsd here is that allocation, not the combined cap: the harness keeps one ledger, and layer 2 is run with the #1835 tools outside it); layer 2 keeps 8 USD (plan: about 5 USD, Fable P 12 pairs x 2 at about 0.21 USD). capUsd 12, stop line 11.5 USD: run-trial.mjs refuses a trial when the ledger total + its budget exceeds it. perTrialUsd 1.5 is the --max-budget-usd of every trial and its ledger reservation, as the #1804 generation (run-gen.mjs --budget 1.5; its sonnet trials of ui02, ui03 and ui08 cost 0.15-0.28 USD). expect: the #1804 maximum 0.28 plus reading ASC (the read trigger) and in S the design-creation body and a reference (about 7 KB) = 0.32; plan = expect x about 1.4. Tokens are rough (#1804 records no token counts per trial): input including cache about 400k, output about 12k per trial. probeUsd 0.6 as #1820 stage 2; the #1843 probes cost about 0.13 USD.

rule.note: The gate of the plan (decision-criteria.md) has a machine part and a part a fresh context counts, blind to the condition (layers/gate-count.json). The harness checks only the machine part in S: per case, the design-creation SKILL.md read (expectReads) in at least 2 of 3 trials. A case whose level fails cannot pass the gate; a case whose level passes still needs the record count. perCondition.S.verdict meets-levels means every case passed the machine part; it is not the gate result (the gate needs 3 judgeable cases of 4, after the record count). The B levels are computed by the harness and not used (B has no design-creation). The report levels (use report) do not enter any verdict. No negative case: rule.negativesRequired false (shared harness #1867).

dryRun.note: B against S: the installed projects may differ only in the design-creation files (the body, the two references, their managed-runtime copies and the Claude Code entry), the Skill list README (the added row) and its copy, the install record, and the managed-runtime copies of the registration (package.json, src/runtime-files.json, src/project-assets.mjs maxAssets) and of release-identity.json. The 17 other entries must be byte-identical (otherEntriesSame). An entry starting with ^ is a regular expression.
